title: Observed comparison frontier for H1 decoding
scope: Conditional on these selected configurations, measured representative-checkpoint costs, and observed six-group means; not a state-of-the-art comparison.

pairing_validation.rule: For each family and outer session, the highest-score selected inner candidate is checked against the profiled transfer checkpoint on all listed inference-cost dimensions.

score_basis.primary: summary.scores, few_shot, all six primary outer groups
score_basis.zero_label_and_dropout: summary.robustness, perturbation=dropout, levels 0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4; the protocol's zero-label condition
score_basis.intervals: Source descriptive 95% group-bootstrap intervals are preserved for display. Frontier membership uses means only; no statistical comparison is implied.

mac_equivalents_per_bin.original_basis: efficiency.families[*].operations_per_bin.total_dense_macs_per_bin; one multiply-accumulate is one MAC, and listed non-GEMM operations are excluded.
mac_equivalents_per_bin.compiled_basis: efficiency.fused_variants[*].operations_per_bin.total_online_mac_equivalents; two-anchor sparse lookups are each counted as a MAC-equivalent. Offline table fusion is excluded.

cpu_p95_ms.unit: milliseconds per one-bin adapter_predict call (CPU p95)
cpu_p95_ms.basis: The measured batch-one adapter_predict p95, including the source-listed causal host normalization, transfer where applicable, model call, and output handling; excludes file I/O, data loading, calibration fitting, and trial scheduling.

gpu_p95_ms.unit: milliseconds per one-bin adapter_predict call (GPU p95)
gpu_p95_ms.basis: The measured batch-one adapter_predict p95, including the source-listed causal host normalization, transfer where applicable, model call, and output handling; excludes file I/O, data loading, calibration fitting, and trial scheduling.

static_memory_mib.original_basis: Resident trained parameter plus registered buffer storage from the representative original checkpoint.
static_memory_mib.compiled_basis: Compiled static tensor bytes from the inference-only representation; it is not a measured process peak or device-wide memory footprint.

measurement_scope.checkpoint_rule: Existing trained transfer checkpoint, training seed 101, fitted on all six held-in groups; codebook_seed=100000+seed=100101

measurement.inference_precision: FP32; TF32 disabled in model forward, autocast disabled
measurement.gpu_model_forward_clock: CUDA events with synchronization every 100 samples and at end
measurement.gpu_adapter_clock: perf_counter_ns around complete predict, synchronized after each returned output
measurement.latency_note: Single process, batch one, sequential causal stream; p50/p95 are empirical timing quantiles and do not establish hard real-time behavior.

measurement_scope.latency_note: Single process, batch one, sequential causal stream; p50/p95 are empirical timing quantiles and do not establish hard real-time behavior.

hdc.variant: FP32 offline fused basis/temporal rotation/input projection plus exact two-anchor sparse interpolation
hdc.accuracy_assignment: Inherits the original family mean and descriptive interval by exact real-valued algebra; no full outer-fold compiled rescore was run.

cpu_numerical_check.comparison: checkpoint adapter prediction and final recurrent hidden state against FP32 sparse fused runtime
cpu_numerical_check.floating_point_note: The real-valued algebra is equivalent; composing GEMMs and changing summation order changes FP32 rounding. Values are checked against the stated tolerances.

gpu_numerical_check.comparison: checkpoint adapter prediction and final recurrent hidden state against FP32 sparse fused runtime
gpu_numerical_check.floating_point_note: The real-valued algebra is equivalent; composing GEMMs and changing summation order changes FP32 rounding. Values are checked against the stated tolerances.

random.variant: FP32 offline fused basis/temporal rotation/input projection plus exact two-anchor sparse interpolation
random.accuracy_assignment: Inherits the original family mean and descriptive interval by exact real-valued algebra; no full outer-fold compiled rescore was run.

cpu_numerical_check.comparison: checkpoint adapter prediction and final recurrent hidden state against FP32 sparse fused runtime
cpu_numerical_check.floating_point_note: The real-valued algebra is equivalent; composing GEMMs and changing summation order changes FP32 rounding. Values are checked against the stated tolerances.

gpu_numerical_check.comparison: checkpoint adapter prediction and final recurrent hidden state against FP32 sparse fused runtime
gpu_numerical_check.floating_point_note: The real-valued algebra is equivalent; composing GEMMs and changing summation order changes FP32 rounding. Values are checked against the stated tolerances.

compiled_accuracy_scope.scope_note: The available numerical comparison used 2,376 input bins from the held-out calibration stream for training seed 101 on CPU and GPU. It is not a full outer-fold score rescore and does not establish accuracy equivalence across outer data by fresh scoring.

dominance_rule.objective: Maximize mean R^2 and minimize one cost at a time.
dominance_rule.strictness: At least one strict improvement is required. At equal cost, a strictly higher mean dominates; an exact mean-and-cost tie leaves both points nondominated.

analyses.label: 60-s calibration
analyses.membership_unit: One participant's six held-out outer session-group means; the family mean and its source interval are copied to both compiled and original points.

mac_equivalents_per_bin.membership_basis: Observed means only; descriptive intervals are retained but do not affect dominance.
mac_equivalents_per_bin.rule: A dominates B iff A.mean_r2 >= B.mean_r2 and A.cost <= B.cost, with at least one strict inequality. Equal-cost points can dominate on score; exact ties do not dominate.
